body: Season 10 opens. Camera Op finds accession register in Rabat matching the scholar on the ship (S09E05). Tyler follows the mechanism to a cave site — first time mechanism directs Tyler's location rather than the reverse. Mechanism returns no taxonomy for what is in the cave. Camera Op finds the scholar's name. TYLER-087, Entry 80, Memo #067. Build 0103.
title: S10E01 Fez: scholar's name found in Rabat; Tyler at cave site — mechanism without taxonomy
